Command.Statement: SELECT NON EMPTY Hierarchize(DrilldownMember(CrossJoin({[Trips].[Pickup area].[All],[Trips].[Pickup area].[Pickup area].Members}, {([Trips].[Time of day].[All])}), {-{[Trips].[Pickup area].&[Bronx]}}, [Trips].[Time of day])) DIMENSION PROPERTIES PARENT_UNIQUE_NAME ON COLUMNS FROM [DS_SAMPLES] WHERE ([Measures].[Trips]) CELL PROPERTIES VALUE, FORMAT_STRING, LANGUAGE, BACK_COLOR, FORE_COLOR, FONT_FLAGS
